name: Reflexion
executive_summary: Extend self-critique across multiple task attempts by storing verbal reflections as memory, so a later attempt can learn from an earlier failure instead of repeating it.
description: After a failed attempt (on a task with an external or internal success signal), the model generates a verbal 'reflection' on what went wrong, which is stored in an episodic memory buffer and included as context in the next attempt. Unlike Self-Refine's single-episode loop, Reflexion persists lessons across separate attempts at the same or similar tasks.
when_to_use: Tasks with multiple attempts and a success/failure signal (agent tasks, coding tasks with test execution, game-playing).
when_not_to_use: Single-shot tasks with no natural retry structure.
known_pitfalls: Memory buffer can accumulate irrelevant or contradictory reflections over many episodes if not curated.

primary_source.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

variables.name: memory_buffer
variables.description: Accumulated reflections from prior failed attempts
